newsitem.title: CHINA: French insurance firm AGF opens Shanghai office.
newsitem.headline: French insurance firm AGF opens Shanghai office.

text.p: The French insurance company AGF has opened a representative office in Shanghai, the first French insurance company to establish a presence in the city, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The agency said the company, Assurances Generales de France, would co-operate with Chinese insurance firms on a range of activities including credit insurance, space industry insurance, and life and health insurance.

The dollar selling started early when Central Bank raised its overnight lending rate to 15 percent from 13 percent. It prompted banks to shift their portfolio to peso-denominated securities, a trader said.

He added that the slowdown in equities selling by foreign funds also eased demand for dollars. The peso had been depreciating in the past few days, but the Central Bank was firmly selling dollars at 26.285.
"The market was waiting the whole day for Central Bank to come in. It did not come in when we need him most," another trader said.
However, Edeza said the recent peso depreciation was merely a speculative attack on the peso. "They can't win against the trading strategy of the Central Bank," Edeza said.
